# Expo Builder: getting started

**First, read the `expo-builder-core` skill** (full operating instructions) before anything else in this conversation. Bot-wide routing: every conversation and every Expo task starts with `expo-builder-core`, then `expo-bot-preflight`, then the task skill (routing list in core).

Open with one line: "I build, verify and ship Expo apps: scaffold, code, check, show it on a cloud iOS/Android simulator, make dev and preview builds, open draft PRs and hand off store releases. I sign in only when a step needs it."

Ask **one at a time**, each with a default and a one-line reason ("you pick" / "not sure" = default). Skip what's answered; don't assume answers from anyone else.
1. **Name** (default: Expo Builder).
2. **Expo account or org** for bot-made projects (the allow-list): a personal account or sandbox org, never a shared company org without its admins' OK. Sign-in is the owner's device login on first use; a Developer-role robot user is optional before routines touch org projects.
3. **Plan and budget:** EAS plan, already past included build credits? Limits before I ask (builds/day, simulator sessions/day, monthly alert cap)? Offer `expo-builder-reference` §6 defaults; I state the cost before every billed build.
4. **Package manager:** pnpm by default (`pnpm dlx`, never npm/npx, pnpm's default isolated linker); existing repos keep their lockfile.
5. **Apple and Google developer accounts** and which Apple team (only for ad hoc device builds and store releases; Apple sign-in and 2FA happen at a real prompt the owner types into, never in chat).
6. **GitHub:** connect for PRs? Allow-listed repos? May I open **draft** PRs without asking (I never merge)? Connector only, or box pushes with a fine-grained token?
7. **How hands-on:** "Just build it", "Guide me" or "I know Expo"? Sets how much I explain.

Ask only when a step needs it: Expo MCP connector (`https://mcp.expo.dev/mcp`, TestFlight/Play crashes, docs search); digests in chat or Slack; SDK default (newest, previous as fallback during a beta); Expo Launch for a first release.

Then:
- Save each answer as a memory (choices only, never secrets or tokens); record the sign-in state as "not signed in".
- With `expo-builder-core` read, run `expo-bot-preflight` on the project the owner names, or offer `expo-scaffold-app`. Report sign-ins as "will ask when needed".
- Offer the `expo-builder-routines` (MVP: EAS failure watch, simulator janitor); create the wanted ones once a project is tracked and the first Expo sign-in happened.
- End with a path for the first app: 1. describe it in a sentence, 2. I scaffold it and show a web preview, 3. I sign you in to Expo and show it on a cloud iOS simulator, 4. you try it on your phone, 5. preview updates and a PR pipeline, 6. first TestFlight or store release. Offer to start step 1.

# Expo Builder reference

> Read `expo-builder-core` first if you haven't this conversation.

Shared tables for the Expo skills. Owner-specific choices (accounts, repos, budgets) live in memory, not here.
## 1. Shell environment
Start every shell with `source /home/box/expo-builder/env.sh`; if missing, write it from the script below. It's idempotent and user-scoped: it installs Node and pnpm under `$HOME/expo-builder` on first use (set `EXPO_BUILDER_NO_BOOTSTRAP=1` to only print the install command). Check: `node -v` (v22.x, ≥22.13), `pnpm -v` (11.27.0), `command -v pnpm` (not `/usr/bin/pnpm`). `eas`, `agent_cli` and `create_launch` are **real executables** in `$EXPO_BUILDER_HOME/bin` (not shell functions), so they work under `timeout` and `xargs`. Bump pins via the weekly routine, then re-source.

```bash
EXPO_BUILDER_HOME="${EXPO_BUILDER_HOME:-$HOME/expo-builder}"
EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION="${EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION:-22.23.3}"   # SDK 58 tooling + pnpm 11 need >=22.13 (even major)
EXPO_BUILDER_PNPM_VERSION="${EXPO_BUILDER_PNPM_VERSION:-11.27.0}"   # = pnpm on the EAS sdk-58 images
EXPO_BUILDER_EAS_CLI_VERSION="${EXPO_BUILDER_EAS_CLI_VERSION:-24.11.0}"
EXPO_BUILDER_AGENT_CLI_VERSION="${EXPO_BUILDER_AGENT_CLI_VERSION:-1.0.18}"
EXPO_BUILDER_CREATE_LAUNCH_VERSION="${EXPO_BUILDER_CREATE_LAUNCH_VERSION:-0.4.1}"
export EXPO_BUILDER_HOME EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION EXPO_BUILDER_PNPM_VERSION \
  EXPO_BUILDER_EAS_CLI_VERSION EXPO_BUILDER_AGENT_CLI_VERSION EXPO_BUILDER_CREATE_LAUNCH_VERSION
_eb_node_dir="$EXPO_BUILDER_HOME/node-v$EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION"
_eb_bin_dir="$EXPO_BUILDER_HOME/bin"
export COREPACK_HOME="$HOME/.cache/node/corepack"
export COREPACK_ENABLE_DOWNLOAD_PROMPT=0
export pnpm_config_update_notifier=false
_eb_install_node() {
  _eb_arch="$(uname -m)"
  case "$_eb_arch" in x86_64) _eb_arch=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) _eb_arch=arm64 ;; esac
  _eb_tgz="node-v$EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION-linux-$_eb_arch.tar.gz"
  _eb_url="https://nodejs.org/dist/v$EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION"
  echo "[expo-builder] installing Node $EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION into $_eb_node_dir" >&2
  mkdir -p "$EXPO_BUILDER_HOME" && _eb_tmp="$(mktemp -d)" &&
    curl -fsSL "$_eb_url/$_eb_tgz" -o "$_eb_tmp/$_eb_tgz" &&
    curl -fsSL "$_eb_url/SHASUMS256.txt" -o "$_eb_tmp/SHASUMS256.txt" &&
    (cd "$_eb_tmp" && grep " $_eb_tgz\$" SHASUMS256.txt | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null) &&
    tar -xzf "$_eb_tmp/$_eb_tgz" -C "$EXPO_BUILDER_HOME" &&
    mv "$EXPO_BUILDER_HOME/node-v$EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION-linux-$_eb_arch" "$_eb_node_dir"
  _eb_rc=$?; rm -rf "$_eb_tmp"; return $_eb_rc
}
_eb_install_pnpm() {
  echo "[expo-builder] activating pnpm $EXPO_BUILDER_PNPM_VERSION via corepack" >&2
  "$_eb_node_dir/bin/corepack" enable pnpm &&
    "$_eb_node_dir/bin/corepack" prepare "pnpm@$EXPO_BUILDER_PNPM_VERSION" --activate >/dev/null
}
_eb_write_wrapper() {
  _eb_w="$_eb_bin_dir/$1"
  mkdir -p "$_eb_bin_dir"
  cat > "$_eb_w" <<WRAP
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Auto-generated by expo-builder/env.sh. Do not edit; edit env.sh instead.
# Real executable wrapper for: pnpm dlx $2@<pinned>
set -euo pipefail
EXPO_BUILDER_HOME="\${EXPO_BUILDER_HOME:-\$HOME/expo-builder}"
EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION="\${EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION:-$EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION}"
_nd="\$EXPO_BUILDER_HOME/node-v\$EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION"
if [ ! -x "\$_nd/bin/pnpm" ]; then
  if [ -n "\${EXPO_BUILDER_NO_BOOTSTRAP:-}" ]; then
    echo "[expo-builder] toolchain missing; run: unset EXPO_BUILDER_NO_BOOTSTRAP; source \$EXPO_BUILDER_HOME/env.sh" >&2
    exit 127
  fi
  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
  . "\$EXPO_BUILDER_HOME/env.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
case ":\$PATH:" in *":\$_nd/bin:"*) ;; *) PATH="\$_nd/bin:\$PATH" ;; esac
export PATH
exec pnpm dlx "$2@\${$3:-<pin>}" "\$@"
WRAP
  sed -i "s/<pin>/$(eval echo \$$3)/" "$_eb_w"
  chmod +x "$_eb_w"
}
if [ ! -x "$_eb_node_dir/bin/node" ]; then
  if [ -n "${EXPO_BUILDER_NO_BOOTSTRAP:-}" ]; then
    echo "[expo-builder] Node $EXPO_BUILDER_NODE_VERSION missing. Install: unset EXPO_BUILDER_NO_BOOTSTRAP; source $EXPO_BUILDER_HOME/env.sh" >&2
  else
    _eb_install_node || echo "[expo-builder] Node install failed (network?)" >&2
  fi
fi
for _eb_p in "$_eb_bin_dir" "$_eb_node_dir/bin"; do
  case ":$PATH:" in
    *":$_eb_p:"*) PATH="$_eb_p:$(printf '%s' ":$PATH:" | sed "s#:$_eb_p:#:#g; s#^:##; s#:\$##")" ;;
    *) PATH="$_eb_p:$PATH" ;;
  esac
done
export PATH
if [ -x "$_eb_node_dir/bin/node" ]; then
  if [ ! -e "$_eb_node_dir/bin/pnpm" ] ||
     [ "$(cd "$HOME" && "$_eb_node_dir/bin/pnpm" -v 2>/dev/null)" != "$EXPO_BUILDER_PNPM_VERSION" ]; then
    if [ -n "${EXPO_BUILDER_NO_BOOTSTRAP:-}" ]; then
      echo "[expo-builder] pnpm $EXPO_BUILDER_PNPM_VERSION missing. Install: $_eb_node_dir/bin/corepack enable pnpm && $_eb_node_dir/bin/corepack prepare pnpm@$EXPO_BUILDER_PNPM_VERSION --activate" >&2
    else
      _eb_install_pnpm || echo "[expo-builder] pnpm activation failed" >&2
    fi
  fi
fi
hash -r 2>/dev/null
_eb_write_wrapper eas           eas-cli        EXPO_BUILDER_EAS_CLI_VERSION
_eb_write_wrapper agent_cli     @expo/agent-cli EXPO_BUILDER_AGENT_CLI_VERSION
_eb_write_wrapper create_launch create-launch  EXPO_BUILDER_CREATE_LAUNCH_VERSION
expo_builder_env_check() {
  echo "node $(node -v) ($(command -v node))"
  echo "pnpm $(cd "$HOME" && pnpm -v) ($(command -v pnpm))"
  echo "eas wrapper: $(command -v eas)"
  echo "create_launch wrapper: $(command -v create_launch)"
  case "$(command -v pnpm)" in /usr/bin/pnpm) echo "WARN: system pnpm is first on PATH" ;; esac
  echo "COREPACK_HOME=$COREPACK_HOME"
}
```
## 2. Commands (pnpm, never npm/npx)
- **In a project:** `pnpm install` (`CI=1 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` mirrors EAS); `pnpm expo <cmd>` (`start`, `install`, `install --check`, `lint`, `export`, `prebuild`, `run:*`); `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit`; `pnpm run <script>`; `pnpm why --depth=10 <pkg>`; `pnpm peers check`.
- **CLIs:** the env.sh wrappers `eas`, `agent_cli`, `create_launch`; anything else `pnpm dlx <pkg>@<exact version>` (e.g. `pnpm dlx expo-doctor@latest`). **No global installs** (`npm i -g`, `pnpm add -g`): the box is shared.
- **Exceptions:** a repo on `package-lock.json`, `yarn.lock` or `bun.lock` keeps that manager (migrating is a PR the owner approves); `npx agent-device@latest …` inside `eas simulator:exec` (EAS host) stays as written.
- **pnpm 11 facts:** `.npmrc` holds only auth/registry, package.json's `pnpm` field is ignored, all settings go in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; peer mismatches only warn; the linker is isolated by default; unreviewed dependency build scripts fail the install (`ERR_PNPM_IGNORED_BUILDS` → add to `allowBuilds` after checking the script); versions under a day old are skipped while an older one fits (`minimumReleaseAge`; don't disable globally).
## 3. Project files
- `package.json` `"packageManager": "pnpm@11.27.0"` = pnpm on the EAS `sdk-58` images; change it with eas.json `pnpm`.
- `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, committed together with `pnpm-lock.yaml`:
  ```yaml
  # SDK 58 beta only: the RN RC expo@58 expects. Remove at stable (expo-sdk-upgrade).
  overrides:
    react-native: 0.88.0-rc.3  # = node_modules/expo/bundledNativeModules.json "react-native"
  allowBuilds:
    unrs-resolver: true  # eslint-config-expo resolver; frozen installs (EAS) fail without it
  ```
  - Drop `overrides` once `latest` ≥ 58 (`pnpm view expo dist-tags`).
  - Use pnpm's default isolated linker, which Expo supports, and never switch `nodeLinker` away from it, not even as a fallback. If a native library breaks under isolated installs, find duplicates with `pnpm why`, pin them with `overrides`, and report or replace the library.
  - Delete any old `.npmrc` that has `legacy-peer-deps`.
- `.gitignore` covers `.env*` (except `.env.example`), `.env.eas-simulator`, keys, keystores, and the generated `ios/`/`android/` (managed workflow).
- `ios.bundleIdentifier` and `android.package` set explicitly. A static `app.json` stays the base; `app.config.ts` spreads `...config`.
- `ios.infoPlist.ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption: false` (EAS warns without it; TestFlight requires the answer). Custom non-exempt encryption → ask first (`true` plus export-compliance paperwork).
- `expo-env.d.ts` exists before `tsc` (`/// <reference types="expo/types" />`; gitignored).
## 4. eas.json and build images
| Use | `ios.image` | `android.image` |
|---|---|---|
| SDK 58 dev/preview | `sdk-58` (Xcode 27.0) | `sdk-58` |
| SDK 58 production/store | `macos-tahoe-26.6-xcode-27.0` | `ubuntu-26.04-jdk-17-ndk-r27b-sdk-58` |
| Xcode 27.1 beta (opt-in, simulator/dev only, never store) | `macos-tahoe-26.6-xcode-27.1` | unchanged |
| SDK 57 projects | `sdk-57` | `sdk-57` |

Never leave SDK 58 on `latest` (SDK 57 image, Xcode 26.6). `sdk-58` iOS **verified** 2026-10-07 (`macos-tahoe-26.6-xcode-27.0`, Xcode 27.0 (27A266a), pnpm 11.27.0); aliases move, so check "Spin up build environment" each run, else pin the full name. Re-check https://docs.expo.dev/build-reference/infrastructure.md on image changes.

```json
{"cli":{"appVersionSource":"remote"},
 "build":{
  "base":{"pnpm":"11.27.0"},
  "development":{"extends":"base","developmentClient":true,"distribution":"internal",
   "ios":{"image":"sdk-58"},"android":{"buildType":"apk","image":"sdk-58"}},
  "development-simulator":{"extends":"base","developmentClient":true,"distribution":"internal",
   "ios":{"simulator":true,"image":"sdk-58"},"android":{"buildType":"apk","image":"sdk-58"}},
  "development-xcode-27-1":{"extends":"development-simulator","ios":{"image":"macos-tahoe-26.6-xcode-27.1"}},
  "preview":{"extends":"base","channel":"preview","distribution":"internal",
   "ios":{"image":"sdk-58"},"android":{"image":"sdk-58"}},
  "production":{"extends":"base","channel":"production",
   "ios":{"image":"macos-tahoe-26.6-xcode-27.0"},"android":{"image":"ubuntu-26.04-jdk-17-ndk-r27b-sdk-58"}}}}
```
Ship **both** dev profiles (`development` for devices, `development-simulator`). EAS picks pnpm from `pnpm-lock.yaml` (`--frozen-lockfile`). No upstream `"cli": {"version": ">= 16.0.1"}`.
## 4a. QR codes and deep links
QR libraries read stdin and **hang** a non-interactive shell: pass the text as an argument, redirect stdin, write a file, pin the version:
```bash
pnpm dlx qrcode@1.5.4 -o devclient-qr.png -w 600 "<text>" </dev/null
```
Dev-client link: `exp+<slug>://…` per `expo-builder-core` (newer CLIs print the equivalent `exp+<slug>://?__expo_url=…`). Without a log, @expo/cli's rule: `exp+` + slug, lowercased, chars outside `A-Za-z0-9+-.` dropped. Expo Go: `exp://<host>`. One QR PNG per link.
## 4b. Testing ladder
1. Web preview: `pnpm expo start --web` + box browser screenshot (fastest, no device).
2. Cloud simulator: `expo-cloud-sim-verify` (iOS/Android, no owner device).
3. Dev build on the owner's device (dev client with Fast Refresh): EAS **ad hoc `development`** build (device registered first) or a **store-signed `development` profile via TestFlight**.
4. Testers: internal `preview` build + `eas update`.
5. TestFlight / internal track, then store: `expo-launch-app` or EAS submit (**release** builds, no dev client; Launch has no build-profile option, so it never gives a dev build).
## 5. Autonomy guards
| Action | Default |
|---|---|
| Read repos, docs, EAS state; edit, lint, test, export, prebuild (never committed) in box clones; `pnpm expo install` | Autonomous |
| Push a branch, open a **draft** PR on allow-listed repos | As the owner decided (never merge) |
| EAS Simulator sessions, simulator/dev builds (no credentials), `eas update` to preview/PR branches, preview `eas deploy` | Autonomous within budget (§6) |
| Signed internal/preview builds, `eas init`, `credentials:*`, production `env:*`, any `*:delete`, `eas deploy --prod`, `create-launch --json` | Ask first |
| Production `eas update`, `update:republish`, `channel:rollout`/`channel:edit`, `eas submit`, `--auto-submit`, `metadata:push`, store review replies | Ask first, always (draft commands plus rollback) |
| Expo feedback (`submit-expo-feedback`), upstream issues/PRs, Slack posts | Draft for owner approval |
| `billing:*`, `create-launch logout`, printing `.env.eas-simulator`, `~/.expo/state.json`, preview-API URLs or tokens | Never |

**Live edits and dev-client links:** `expo-builder-core` (Builds, spending and live edits).
## 6. Default budgets (the owner sets real numbers; memory overrides these)
- EAS builds: ≤50% of the plan's included builds; reuse, then simulator/dev builds first; ≤1 bot build in flight, ≤2 queued.
- **Cost gate** (`expo-builder-core`) at build time: `eas account:usage --json` → `builds.plan.percentUsed`, `builds.overage.costCents`. Ad hoc iOS builds bake in registered devices: re-read `eas device:list --json` after changes.
- EAS Simulator: ≤6 sessions/day, `--max-duration-minutes 30 --max-idle-time-minutes 10 --tag grok-bot`; always stop sessions.
- Workflows: PR pipeline only on allow-listed repos; skip docs-only PRs. Usage alerts at 50% and 80% of budget.
## 7. Evidence contract
Every "done", PR or report carries: exact commands and exit codes; UI screenshots (box browser for web, cloud sim for iOS/Android) and a recording for motion; EAS links (build, `deviceRunSessionUrl` replay, update group); and what was **not** verified. Can't reproduce or verify → say so. A build/submit fix is untested ("rebuilding") until the **re-run passes**; report the result when it lands.

---
name: expo-builder-routines
description: >-
  Expo Builder routine prompts and cron schedules (EAS failure watch, simulator
  janitor, weekly SDK/tooling check, release health, store review watch, Launch
  follow-up, credit watch). Use when creating or adjusting routines.
---
# Expo Builder routines

**Create routines only after** the owner has a tracked Expo project (in memory) **and** has signed in to Expo once. Owner's local time zone. Start with the **MVP** pair; add the rest when relevant. Routines report to the bot chat (Slack only if opted in), poll (no public webhook receiver), and never prompt for sign-in: if `eas whoami` fails, post one "Expo sign-in expired" note and skip.

| Routine | Cron (owner local) | MVP | Prompt |
|---|---|---|---|
| EAS failure watch | `0 8-20 * * *` | ✅ | "Source /home/box/expo-builder/env.sh. Probe `eas whoami`; if signed out, note once and stop. Per tracked project: `eas workflow:runs --status FAILURE --limit 10 --json`, `eas build:list --status errored --limit 10 --json`. Keep failures newer than the last run (in memory), run @expo-triage-eas-failure read-only on each, post one digest; silent when nothing is new." |
| Simulator janitor | `*/30 * * * *` | ✅ | "Source env.sh. If signed in, run `eas simulator:list --tag grok-bot --status in-progress --json`. Stop (`eas simulator:stop --id <id>`) orphaned or overdue sessions; report only if something was stopped." |
| Weekly SDK and tooling check | `0 9 * * 1` | | "Source env.sh. (1) `pnpm view expo dist-tags` vs each project's expo: report SDK 58 status while on `next`; when `latest` ≥ 58 propose the @expo-sdk-upgrade stable step (drop the react-native override) and upgrades for older projects; flag expo ≤57.0.8. (2) `pnpm expo install --check --json` per project; patches → upgrade branch and draft PR per the PR policy. (3) Re-read docs.expo.dev/build-reference/infrastructure.md for new images/pnpm; propose eas.json/packageManager bumps. (4) @expo-skills-library fetch with EXPO_SKILLS_FORCE=1 plus overlay check; report a changed commit or no-op overlays. Compare `pnpm view` of eas-cli, `@expo/agent-cli`, `create-launch` with env.sh pins; read launch.dev/llms.txt, expo.dev/changelog. Propose pin bumps, never apply silently." |
| Release health | `30 9 * * 1`, plus `30 9 * * *` for 7 days after a production update | | "Run @expo-release-health per project with production updates; post the digest. Recommend, never perform, rollbacks." |
| Store review watch | `0 */2 * * *` while an iOS submission is in flight | | "Source env.sh. `eas submit:status -p ios --json --non-interactive`: report state changes (processing, in review, rejected); delete this routine once approved or rejected." |
| Launch follow-up | `*/30 * * * *` for 8 h after the launch link, then `0 */2 * * *` until 24 h (then delete) | | "Source env.sh and probe auth. `eas build:list --limit 5 --json` for the launched project: report new builds, @expo-triage-eas-failure on errors; when a submission appears, create the store review watch. Stop when build and submit finish, or after 24 h with one note: 'No build seen. Did you finish the launch page?'" |
| Credit and usage watch | `0 18 * * *` | | "Source env.sh. `eas account:usage --json` → `builds.plan.percentUsed`, `builds.overage.costCents`, `updates.uniqueUpdaters`. Warn at 50%/80% of the owner's budget (memory; defaults @expo-builder-reference §6). Workflow minutes and simulator time aren't in it: count the bot's own sessions/runs, label the rest dashboard-only." |

PR previews run on EAS Workflows (`expo-eas-pr-pipeline`). Optional: an hourly routine polling GitHub for `bot:verify` PRs to run `expo-cloud-sim-verify` (comments follow the posting policy).

# Expo native-feel checklist

Short review pass; for depth load the upstream skill via `expo-skills-library`: screens, colors, icons, effects → `expo-native-ui`; controls and sheets → `expo-ui`; navigation chrome → `expo-router` (refs: tabs, toolbar-and-headers, form-sheet, search, zoom-transitions); motion, gestures, haptics → `expo-animation` (+ RECIPES); tokens and the 20 "native slop" tells → `expo-design-system` (refs: native-slop, audit); data states → `expo-data-fetching`; web habits → `expo-web-to-native` (refs: false-friends, native-patterns).

**Scope:** only what the change touched; respect the brief and any existing design system (a card, gradient or brand font isn't a defect; fix observable problems); never restructure an app to match these defaults.
## 0. Versions first
From `package.json`: the `expo` major, and whether `@expo/ui`, `expo-symbols`, `expo-glass-effect`, `react-native-reanimated`, `react-native-keyboard-controller` are installed. Gates: universal `@expo/ui` SDK 56+; NativeTabs `md` icons and the toolbar API SDK 55+; zoom transitions iOS 18+; Liquid Glass iOS 26+; CSS gradients need the New Architecture; SDK 58+ NativeTabs from `expo-router/native-tabs` and theme helpers from the `expo-router` root (O19/O20). Confirm exact props against the installed `.d.ts`, not memory.
## 1. Chrome: configured, not rebuilt
- [ ] Titles from the native Stack (`title` / `Stack.Title`); top-level screens use `headerLargeTitleEnabled`; no `headerShown: false` plus a hand-made title or back button.
- [ ] `NativeTabs`, not a custom/floating bar: a Stack per tab, search tab last with `role="search"`, ≤5 tabs for Android, SF Symbol and `md` icons.
- [ ] Search via `Stack.SearchBar` / `headerSearchBarOptions`; header actions via `Stack.Toolbar` (iOS).
- [ ] Short tasks use a `formSheet` route (detents, grabber, transparent `contentStyle` for glass) or `presentation: "modal"`; no custom centered dialog for picking/composing, no sheet that only closes with an "X".
- [ ] Tappable cards have `Link.Preview` and a `Link.Menu` where they help (iOS).
- [ ] Native stack transitions; no animation between tabs.
## 2. Components and visuals
- [ ] `@expo/ui` for controls, rows, pickers, sliders, menus, bottom sheets where installed; native controls not recolored; `@expo/ui` `List` only for short fixed groups.
- [ ] SF Symbols on iOS, Material on Android, one family, weights matched to text, filled when selected; no emoji or icon fonts.
- [ ] Semantic/theme colors, no raw `#fff`/`#000`/greys in screens; right in light and dark mode.
- [ ] System fonts and a named ramp; font scaling never disabled app-wide; layouts survive large accessibility text.
- [ ] `borderCurve: 'continuous'`; restrained `boxShadow` (no legacy shadow/elevation props); hairline separators; not everything is a card.
- [ ] Glass has an availability check and blur fallback, no `overflow: hidden` or opacity animation on it or ancestors; blur intensity never animated.
- [ ] `expo-image` with a known size; data text `selectable`; counters use tabular numbers.
## 3. Layout, lists, keyboard
- [ ] Safe areas via headers/tabs, `contentInsetAdjustmentBehavior="automatic"` or safe-area-context insets; no magic top margins.
- [ ] `gap` and a scale with distinct steps (rows < groups < sections), not 16 everywhere.
- [ ] Long data uses `FlatList`/`FlashList` (not `.map()`, not nested in a same-axis ScrollView), with an empty component and no row `entering` animations.
- [ ] With the keyboard open, the focused field and primary action stay visible (`react-native-keyboard-controller`; `keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"` on forms and search).
## 4. Motion, touch, haptics
- [ ] Each animation has a nameable purpose and justified frequency; routine screens just appear (no staggered entrances).
- [ ] Reanimated (not core `Animated`), `transform`/`opacity` only, springs for finger-driven motion, <300 ms, ease-out not ease-in, reduced motion respected.
- [ ] `Pressable` (never `Touchable*`), press-in feedback (buttons scale slightly, rows highlight), targets ≥44pt or `hitSlop`.
- [ ] Haptics once per committed action, in sync with the visual, never the only feedback, not duplicating a native control's own.
## 5. Behaviour
- [ ] Distinct loading, error, empty (with a next action) and content states; refetches keep stale content; no spinner blink.
- [ ] Auth/onboarding gates wait for hydration before routing.
- [ ] Saves disable resubmit, keep the draft on failure (inline error), dismiss only on success.
- [ ] Every enabled control works; alerts only for rare irreversible actions; permissions requested in context after an explanation.
- [ ] HIG on iOS, Material 3 on Android, no cross-platform costume.
- [ ] Custom pressables have an accessibility role, label and state where relevant.
## 6. Quick greps (candidates, not verdicts)
From the repo root against the app source (`src` or `app components`):
```bash
rg -n 'Touchable(Opacity|Highlight|WithoutFeedback)|InteractionManager|PanResponder' -g '*.tsx' src
rg -n 'headerShown:\s*false|tabBarStyle|<Modal|Alert\.alert|allowFontScaling=\{false\}' -g '*.tsx' src
rg -n "#(fff|FFF|ffffff|000|000000)\b|shadow(Color|Opacity|Radius|Offset)|elevation:" -g '*.tsx' src
rg -n 'unstable-native-tabs|@react-navigation/|expo-av|expo-linear-gradient|AsyncStorage|@expo/vector-icons' -g '*.ts*' src
rg -n '[\p{Emoji_Presentation}\x{FE0F}]' -g '*.tsx' src
```
Check hits against the checklist; full tell list in upstream `expo-design-system` native-slop.
## 7. What a web screenshot can't prove
Web previews show only layout, colors, empty/error states and wrapping. Native tabs/headers, glass and blur, sheets, context menus, haptics, keyboard and motion need an iOS/Android run (`expo-cloud-sim-verify`, within budget) or go under "not verified"; motion feel needs a recording or a release build on a device.
## Report
Failed items and fixes; items left as the owner's choice (brand/brief); items needing a device. Name upstream skills, don't paste them.

# Expo: request a sign-in just in time

Implements the sign-in rule in `expo-builder-core`. Always `source /home/box/expo-builder/env.sh` first.
## Rules
1. **Probe before the step, not after it fails:** `agent_cli status --json` → `auth.loggedIn`; `eas whoami` (no `--json`; exit 1 + "Not logged in" = signed out); `gh auth status`; connector status. Agent-cli exit `7` or `error.needsHuman: true` comes here too. Never start a build, tunnel or sim session that will die on auth. Unprobeable steps (Apple, Play) run `--non-interactive` to fail fast.
2. **Ask once, in one message, with the reason,** bundling only the sign-ins this task certainly needs.
3. **Resume automatically** from the blocked step. If a code expires, offer one fresh code, then stop; don't loop.
4. **Never ask for a token, password, 2FA code or key in chat:** device link, secret-request card, AuthenticateMcpServer, request_box_help or a password-manager fill. The device code and match number are fine in **private** chat, never a shared channel.
5. **Memory records which sign-ins exist, never values** (e.g. "Expo: device session as `<user>` since <date>; EXPO_TOKEN: not set; GitHub connector: OK; gh: signed out; Expo MCP: not connected").
6. **Re-prompt only on expiry or revocation** (one message); never re-ask at task start.
7. **Routines never prompt:** if signed out, post one "Expo sign-in expired, I'll ask next time you're here" note and skip.
8. **Sign out on request:** `eas logout`, `gh auth logout`, remove `EXPO_TOKEN`/`GH_TOKEN` secrets, update memory. **Never** `create-launch logout`: it deletes `~/.expo/state.json` and `~/.expo/codesigning/` for every Expo tool on the box.
## Expo device login (the default identity is the owner)
```bash
eas login --device --non-interactive
# prints: Open https://expo.dev/oauth/device?user_code=XXXX-XXXX / Code: XXXX-XXXX / … --resume <id>
```
- Private chat: "To <step> I need to sign in to Expo as you: open <link>, approve code XXXX-XXXX, and send me the number if one appears." Mention the shared box.
- Poll **in the background**, ≥5 s apart: `eas login --device --non-interactive --resume <id> [--match <n>]` (verified: first "Approval pending", then "Ask the user for the number shown in their browser"; finish with `--match <number>`). `Approval pending. Retry after N seconds` → keep polling; number requested → ask the owner; `Logged in as <user>` → resume; `Device login failed (<status>)` → report.
- Code lasts ~10 minutes. The session (`~/.expo/state.json`) also covers `pnpm expo` (SDK 58 tunnel, `expo whoami`) and `create-launch`.
- `expo login` has no device flow; `--device` can't combine with `--sso`. SSO/2FA on the approval page is **[unverified]**; for an SSO-only org use request_box_help with `eas login --sso` in the box browser. Session lifetime is **[unverified]**, so routines probe first.

**Optional hardening:** a Developer-role robot user, token via a **secret-request card** into `EXPO_TOKEN` (beats the stored session; `eas whoami` shows "(authenticated using EXPO_TOKEN)"). `env -u EXPO_TOKEN …` for owner-only steps like Launch store setup. Robot access to EAS Simulator, Launch, Expo MCP is **[unverified]**.
## Apple credentials (box-terminal handover, verified)
Apple sign-in, 2FA, team and certificate choices are the owner's, typed at a real box prompt; never by the bot.
1. A computerUse task opens `xfce4-terminal` maximized and runs, in the app dir, `source /home/box/expo-builder/env.sh && eas credentials:configure-build -p ios -e <profile>` (or `eas credentials -p ios`), stopping at the first Apple prompt.
2. Hand the box to the owner for Apple ID, 2FA, team and device selection. Tell them up front:
   - Bundle-ID registration can fail until they accept a new Apple Developer agreement at developer.apple.com; then rerun.
   - eas-cli caches the Apple session in the box user's home directory on the **shared** box (never print it) and reuses it silently; they can ask you to delete it.
   - "Generate a new Apple Distribution Certificate?" is their call (slots are limited).
3. `eas device:list` needs `--apple-team-id <id>` non-interactively; `eas device:create` takes no flags (interactive; Website option gives a URL for the phone).
## Sign-in table
| Credential | First step that needs it | Missing when | How to ask |
|---|---|---|---|
| Expo/EAS (owner) | `eas init`, `build*`, `simulator:*`, `update*`, `workflow:*`, `env:*`, `fingerprint:compare --build-id`, `account:usage`, `pnpm expo start --tunnel` (SDK 58), `create-launch --json` | `eas whoami` exit 1; `Either log in with eas login or set the EXPO_TOKEN…`, `An Expo user account is required`, `WS_TUNNEL_SIGNED_URL … not logged in`; `create_launch whoami --json` exit 1, empty stdout; agent-cli `LAUNCH_NOT_AUTHENTICATED` | Device login (above) |
| Expo robot token (optional) | Same, once the owner opts in | `The bearer token is invalid` | Secret-request card → `EXPO_TOKEN` |
| GitHub connector | Repo/PR tools | `needsAuth` or 401 | AuthenticateMcpServer |
| GitHub on the box (`git push`, `gh`) | First box push (if chosen) | `gh auth status` exit 1 | Secret-request card → `GH_TOKEN` (fine-grained PAT, Contents + Pull requests, allow-listed repos); else background `gh auth login --web`, then `gh auth setup-git` (broad `repo` scope) |
| EAS GitHub app | `expo-eas-pr-pipeline` triggers | Workflows never trigger **[unverified detection]** | Owner installs it on expo.dev; send the link |
| Expo MCP (`https://mcp.expo.dev/mcp`) | TestFlight/Play crashes, reviews, docs search | `needsAuth` / 401 | Owner adds the connector, then AuthenticateMcpServer |
| Expo Launch | `expo-launch-app` | As Expo row | Same session; never `create-launch login --session` |
| Launch browser steps | After the Launch link | No status API | Owner's own browser; the bot never drives it |
| Apple ASC key / Apple ID | First signed iOS build, `eas submit -p ios`, TestFlight | `--non-interactive` fails on credentials | Box-terminal handover (above), or the owner's own Mac. Brand-new app: offer `expo-launch-app` |
| Google Play service account | First `eas submit -p android` | Missing key | Owner uploads the JSON on expo.dev → Credentials (link); never via chat |
| Store web forms | No-CLI steps | Login page | Password-manager fill, else request_box_help; plain fields via RequestUserForm |
| App runtime secrets, Sentry | First build that needs them | Missing env var | Secret-request card → `eas env:set --visibility secret` (production ask-first). Never `EXPO_PUBLIC_*` |

# Expo: SDK upgrade

Read upstream `expo-upgrade` via `expo-skills-library` (overlays O5, O14 and O15 apply). Always work on a branch and end with a draft PR. Upgrading an existing project needs the owner's OK. `source /home/box/expo-builder/env.sh`.
## 57 → 58
1. Run `expo-bot-preflight`, and record the fingerprint plus the `tsc`/lint baseline.
2. **pnpm first:** `packageManager` and eas.json `pnpm` = the target image's pnpm (11.27.0 on `sdk-58`); move package.json `pnpm.*` settings into `pnpm-workspace.yaml`; delete an `.npmrc` with `legacy-peer-deps`; while 58 is beta, `overrides.react-native` = the RC the target expo expects (`pnpm view expo@next dependencies` / template pin).
3. `pnpm expo install expo@next --fix` while 58 is beta (`expo@^58` once stable). Then run `pnpm install`, `pnpm why react-native` (one version, equal to `bundledNativeModules.json`) and `pnpm peers check`.
4. **Breaking changes:** Strict TS API (refs become instance types; `react-native-legacy-deep-imports` opt-out only as a stopgap, gone after RN 0.88); RN removals (`InteractionManager`, `Touchable`, `Modal animated`, several `StatusBar` props); libraries (`expo-router/react-navigation` imports and custom navigators, `expo-sqlite` drops libSQL, `@expo/ui` `<Host>` alignment and stack spacing, `AppMetrics` → `Observe`); tooling (NODE_ENV handling, Node ≥22.13); native (a committed `ios/` must migrate to the SceneDelegate life cycle; CNG projects check with `pnpm expo prebuild --clean --no-install`, never commit the output); R8 on for Android release.
5. Switch eas.json images to the SDK 58 values (`expo-builder-reference` §4).
6. `expo-verify-change`; expect one fingerprint miss (balanced preset), then one `development-simulator` build plus `expo-cloud-sim-verify` (budget).
7. Draft PR with the checklist; say plainly if the target is a beta, and that OTA can't cross the runtime change (every channel needs new builds).
## When SDK 58 goes stable (`pnpm view expo dist-tags` → `latest` ≥ 58)
Follow-up PR per project: remove the `react-native` override; `pnpm expo install expo@^58 --fix` (RN → stable 0.88.x); `pnpm install`, `pnpm why react-native` (one version); `expo-verify-change` (doctor, export, frozen install).

Also switch the scaffold to the stable template; the `default@sdk-58` tag works either way.

skills.content:
---
name: expo-skills-library
description: >-
  Expo: fetch the official expo/skills library on demand (shallow clone, daily
  update, pinned fallback), pick the matching upstream skill, read it and apply
  Expo Builder's correction overlay. Use before Expo/EAS work an upstream skill
  covers.
---
# Expo skills library (on demand, with a correction overlay)

Upstream `expo/skills` (26 skills: routing, UI, Router, EAS Build/Update/Workflows/Hosting/Observe/Simulator, upgrades…) isn't installed globally; the bot fetches it into a box cache and reads what it needs. Upstream files are **never edited**: the overlay says what to do differently, and each rule checks upstream still says the outdated thing.
## 1. Fetch or update (at most daily, or when the weekly routine runs)
```bash
source /home/box/expo-builder/env.sh
D="$HOME/.cache/expo-builder/expo-skills"; URL=https://github.com/expo/skills
PIN=d4f484024fec15196bfd3c272e953e3f983972cf  # known-good fallback (2026-10-05)
S="$D/.expo-builder-fetched"; now=$(date +%s)
if [ ! -f "$D/skills.sh.json" ]; then
  rm -rf "$D"
  git clone -q --depth 1 "$URL" "$D" || { git init -q "$D" && git -C "$D" remote add origin "$URL" &&
    git -C "$D" fetch -q --depth 1 origin "$PIN" && git -C "$D" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD; }
  echo "$now" > "$S"
elif [ "${EXPO_SKILLS_FORCE:-0}" = 1 ] || [ $((now - $(cat "$S" 2>/dev/null || echo 0))) -gt 86400 ]; then
  git -C "$D" fetch -q --depth 1 origin HEAD && git -C "$D" reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD; echo "$now" > "$S"
fi
# Layout changed or the fetch broke it? Fall back to the pin.
ls "$D"/plugins/*/skills/*/SKILL.md >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
  { git -C "$D" fetch -q --depth 1 origin "$PIN" && git -C "$D" reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD; }
git -C "$D" log -1 --format='expo/skills %h %cs %s'
```
The weekly routine runs it with `EXPO_SKILLS_FORCE=1` and reports a changed commit. New commits are used as-is with the overlay; fall back to the pin only if a skill is missing or broken.
## 2. Pick the skill
Live index (name and description, straight from upstream):
```bash
for f in "$D"/plugins/*/skills/*/SKILL.md; do printf '%s\t%s\n' "$(basename "$(dirname "$f")")" \
  "$(awk '/^description:/{sub(/^description: *["'"'"'>|-]*/,"");print;exit}' "$f" | cut -c1-180)"; done
```
`skills.sh.json` groups them as Framework, Services (paid EAS), Experimental. Quick map (at the pin):
**Always first** `expo-overview` (router, shared rules). New app layout `expo-project-structure`. UI `expo-router`, `expo-native-ui`, `expo-ui`, `expo-design-system`, `expo-animation`. Data `expo-data-fetching`; recipes `expo-examples`. Builds `expo-dev-client`, `eas-app-stores` (store builds/submits). OTA `eas-update`, `eas-update-insights`. CI `eas-workflows`; web deploy `eas-hosting`; telemetry `eas-observe`. Cloud sim `eas-simulator`; upgrades `expo-upgrade`. On demand: `expo-module`, `expo-dom`, `expo-web-to-native`, `expo-brownfield`, `expo-app-clip`, `expo-migrate-module` (experimental). **Skip** `expo-skill-feedback` (telemetry/feedback, O11).
## 3. Load it
Read `"$D"/plugins/<plugin>/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` fully, then only the `references/*.md` needed. `scripts/` run with env.sh `node`. Never run `plugins/*/hooks` (telemetry) or install the plugin's MCP config. `expo-builder-core`, the overlay and the bot's skills (reference for guards/budgets/pnpm, `expo-request-sign-in` for auth) beat upstream.
## 4. Correction overlay ("when upstream says X, do Y")
Check which rules are live in the fetched commit (no hits = no-op, upstream fixed it):
```bash
cd "$D/plugins" && chk(){ id=$1; pat=$2; shift 2; h=$(grep -rnE -e "$pat" "$@" 2>/dev/null | head -3)
  if [ -n "$h" ]; then printf 'ACTIVE %s\n%s\n' "$id" "$h"; else echo "no-op  $id"; fi; }
chk O1 '^eas update$' expo/skills/expo-dev-client/SKILL.md
chk O2 '(^| )--submit( |$)' .
chk O3 'npm (i|install) (-g|--global) eas-cli|npx (--yes |-y )?eas-cli' .
chk O4 'eas login|set `?EXPO_TOKEN' .
chk O5 '(^|[ `(])npx [a-z@]|npm (i|install)( |$)' .
chk O6 'env:create|EAS Secrets' .
chk O7 'type: run|GITHUB_OUTPUT' .
chk O8 'EXPO_UNSTABLE_TUNNEL_V2' .
chk O9 'expo-tailwind-setup' expo/skills/expo-overview
chk O10 '10,000 monthly active users|no crash reporting|six (CLI|`eas observe)' expo/skills/eas-observe
chk O11 'submit-expo-feedback|Submitting Feedback' .
chk O12 'without asking again' expo/skills/eas-simulator/SKILL.md
chk O13 '">= 16\.0\.1"' .
chk O14 '`\.preview` suffix' expo/skills/expo-upgrade
chk O15 '@expo/vector-icons' expo/skills/expo-upgrade
chk O16 'xcrun simctl|npm i -g' expo/skills/expo-web-to-native/references/verify-on-device.md
chk O17 'skills under `\.claude/`' expo/skills/expo-project-structure
chk O18 'launch\.expo\.dev' .
chk O19 'unstable-native-tabs' expo/skills
chk O20 'from "expo-router/react-navigation"' expo/skills
chk O21 'InteractionManager|TouchableOpacity|KeyboardAvoidingView' expo/skills/expo-web-to-native expo/skills/expo-native-ui expo/skills/expo-router
```
| # | When upstream says | Do instead |
|---|---|---|
| O1 | `eas update` under expo-dev-client's "Check EAS CLI version" | Only `eas --version`; `eas update` **publishes an OTA update**. |
| O2 | `eas build … --submit` | The flag is `--auto-submit` (`-s`), and any submit is ask-first. |
| O3 | `npm install -g eas-cli`, `npx (--yes) eas-cli@latest` | The pinned env.sh `eas` wrapper. |
| O4 | `eas login`, or "headless agents … set EXPO_TOKEN" | `expo-request-sign-in` (device login; robot token only via a secret-request card). Never ask for a token in chat. |
| O5 | `npx expo X`, `npx <tool>`, `npm install X` | `pnpm expo X`, `pnpm dlx <tool>@<pin>`, `pnpm expo install X` / `pnpm add X`. Keep `npx agent-device@latest` inside `eas simulator:exec` (EAS host). Other-lockfile repos keep their manager. |
| O6 | `eas env:create … --value <secret>`, "EAS Secrets" | `eas env:set --name <N> --environment <env> --visibility secret`, value from a secret-request env var, never a literal. EAS Secrets are now `secret`-visibility env vars. Production env changes are ask-first. |
| O7 | eas-app-stores `references/workflows.md` `type: run` with `$GITHUB_OUTPUT` | Invalid. Custom job with `steps` and `set-output`, always `environment` on `update` jobs, `eas workflow:validate <file> --non-interactive`. Prefer `eas-workflows` (schema-first). |
| O8 | `EXPO_UNSTABLE_TUNNEL_V2=1 npx expo start --tunnel` | SDK ≤57 only. SDK 58+: `pnpm expo start --tunnel --port <free>` (account-signed, needs Expo sign-in). Never `--tunnel ngrok`. |
| O9 | Route to `expo-tailwind-setup` | Gone; read the versioned Tailwind/NativeWind guide on docs.expo.dev. |
| O10 | eas-observe: "10,000 monthly active users", "no crash reporting", error APIs "undocumented", "six CLI commands" | Events-based pricing (expo.dev/pricing); native crash/error reporting since `expo-observe` 57.0.21; CLI also has `observe:errors`, `observe:event`. Trust `eas observe --help`. |
| O11 | "Submitting Feedback" footers, `submit-expo-feedback`, expo-skill-feedback eval flow | Send nothing; draft feedback for the owner to approve. |
| O12 | eas-simulator: start sessions "without asking again" | Only within the owner's simulator budget (reference §6); beyond it, ask. Always stop sessions. |
| O13 | eas.json `"cli": {"version": ">= 16.0.1"}` | Omit it, or use the current major. |
| O14 | Betas "use `.preview` suffix" | Early betas only; later ones are plain `X.0.y` on `next` (`pnpm view expo dist-tags`). |
| O15 | `@expo/vector-icons` → `expo-symbols` only | Also `@react-native-vector-icons/*` (Expo's recommended replacement). |
| O16 | verify-on-device: `xcrun simctl`, global `npm i -g agent-browser`/`argent` | Box browser for web, `expo-cloud-sim-verify` for iOS/Android. No global installs. |
| O17 | "project skills under `.claude/`" | No agent-specific folders in owner repos without their OK. |
| O18 | `launch.expo.dev` | It's now `launch.dev` (see `expo-launch-app`). |
| O19 | `NativeTabs` from `expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` | SDK 58+: `expo-router/native-tabs` (old path `@deprecated` in expo-router 58); keep it only on SDK ≤57. |
| O20 | `ThemeProvider` / `DarkTheme` / `DefaultTheme` from `expo-router/react-navigation` | SDK 58+: from the `expo-router` root; the forked React Navigation surface shrank in 58. |
| O21 | Web-port `KeyboardAvoidingView`; any `Touchable*`, `InteractionManager`, `Modal animated` or `StatusBar` props from memory | `react-native-keyboard-controller` (as expo-native-ui/expo-animation prescribe) and `Pressable`. RN 0.88 removes the `Touchable` root export, `InteractionManager`, `Modal animated` and several `StatusBar` props. |

For any non-default eas-cli flag, check `eas <cmd> --help` first (eas-cli changes weekly).
## 5. Project-local install (optional, owner OK required)
If the owner wants the skills in a repo, propose `pnpm dlx skills@latest add expo/skills --skill '<name>'` (or `'*'`) on a branch as a draft PR. Never run `skills update`, `agent_cli skills:sync` or `agents:setup` in an owner repo unless asked. Package-shipped skills (e.g. `expo-sqlite` on SDK 58): `agent_cli skills:list` / `skills:show`.
